sourceNote: Printed page 131: chapter heading Hockey (ہاکی), playing-field dimensions (length, width, shooting circle, penalty stroke, penalty corner, corner), goal post (distance, height, board), and a pitch diagram. Yards are printed as “گز”. The page number “131” is shown in a hexagon at the foot. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark and footer strip excluded.
